prompt:
Create ONE finished vertical 2:3 poster, high-detail, with faithful likenesses of exactly two real adult friends, Sean and Brett. All supplied photos are IDENTITY REFERENCES, not layout targets. Reference 1 is Sean's primary facial reference. Reference 2 is the SAME Sean and supplies build, hairstyle, watch, tattoo; preserve only his actual referenced tattoo when visible. Reference 3 is Brett's facial/build reference. Sean has dark voluminous swept-up hair, light eyes and light facial stubble; Brett has shorter light brown/blond swept-up hair, light eyes and is largely clean-shaven. Strictly preserve their distinct facial structures and identifiable noses, eye spacing, lips, hairlines and body shapes even in stylized interpretations. Do not merge them, make them twins, genericize, or beautify. For animation/comics translate recognizable features faithfully into the medium. Both have equal narrative dignity and agency. In a simple pair arrangement Sean is on viewer's left and Brett on right, unless panels require clearly identified consistent positions. Dress both casually: Sean navy/black short sleeves when appropriate; Brett charcoal and muted olive. Use the reference photo of shirtless Brett only for identity and build; the poster may dress him naturally. No source watermarks, camera timestamps, phone UI, or copied photo backgrounds. These are imaginative illustrations of their friendship, not depictions of verified historical events. No extra people. Excellent typography with exact requested wording, natural hands, strong focal hierarchy, professional margins. Only the text requested for this specific poster. No stock logos or watermarks.

Relationship grounding: genuine brotherhood, reciprocal support and creative collaboration; theater and writing, music/audio/technical experimentation, daily gaming, gift pranks with pizza, late nights and hopes for a future theater/farm. They can challenge one another, misread tone, apologize, laugh and reconnect. Humor includes wordplay, exaggerated seriousness, callbacks, intentional childish language, absurd escalation and affectionate irreverence. There is no permanently superior mentor, helpless dependent or villain. Treat emotional pain with dignity. Dark humor may be profane, absurd and gallows-like but should not include slurs, sexual violence, explicit sex, actual self-harm, or ridicule of vulnerable people. Neither man is deceased. Avoid memorial imagery. Every poster must have a genuinely different visual language and composition from the previous warm painted worktable mural.

SPECIFIC POSTER:
A sharply funny dark satirical illustrated theater poster in sophisticated noir cartoon style, original adult-animation linework, deep midnight green, burgundy, dirty gold and spotlight cream. Sean and Brett, accurately recognizable, sit in absurdly solemn committee chairs at a tiny table labeled by a paper placard "TERRIBLE IDEAS COMMITTEE". Around them lean enormous precarious stacks of revised scripts, a laptop displaying a gigantic spinning loading symbol, an empty pizza box, and a clock showing 3:07; a single stage spotlight gives the chaos unearned bureaucratic grandeur. Both wear casual clothes with comically over-serious expressions while clearly trying not to laugh. Brett's speech balloon "ARE WE BEING PRODUCTIVE?" Sean's speech balloon "EMOTIONALLY? DEBATABLE." Exact big title at top "EVERYTHING IS FINE. PROBABLY." Small footer "GO FUCKIN' TEAM." Dark comedy comes from overcommitment, tired bravado and grandiose formality applied to mundane chaos. No actual disasters, trauma scenes, slurs, explicit sex or harm. Readable carefully spaced type, faces central, maximum witty small detail without clutter.

ADDITIONAL BRETT REFERENCES: References4 and5 are additional photos of Brett, the SAME man as reference3. Reference4 shows his more recent longer wavy brown hair and facial expression. Reference5 provides another clear close face. Use these to refine Brett's recognizable identity and use longer wavy hair for this poster. Sean remains the man in references1 and2. Still exactly two men.
quality: Visually checked: distinct Sean-left/Brett-right identities; recent wavy Brett hair; exact title, footer and dialogue, natural hands; added incidental readable labels on paper stacks consistent with the brief; no material failure.
